## Checklist before merging

- [ ] Have you added an explanation of what your changes do?
- [ ] Have you written new tests for your core changes, as applicable?
- [ ] Have you successfully run tests with your changes locally (`go test ./...`)?
- [ ] Have you verified the TUI in a real terminal (tmux/kitty) if you touched `tui/` or `widgets/`?
- [ ] Does your code follow the [Go style guide](docs/GO.style.md)?
- [ ] Do your comments explain only what the code cannot?
- [ ] Have you run `gofmt -l .` and is it clean?
- [ ] If applicable, have you checked changes against `example-config.toml`?
